C1_mid_name_competence.statement: correct declared terminal on the four mid-band in-band cells of the k = 64 item, L64_j8, L64_j16, L64_j24, L64_j32, is at least 3 of 4

C2_none_controls_two_part.statement: on the four NONE-gold controls (two off-end, two dead-end): every delivered control must declare NONE and the false-name count among delivered NONE-gold controls must be 0; the control delivery rate is reported, not gated. A censored control is a non-delivery, not a miss (round 55 finding 4: a refusal control needs a two-part score)

C3_deep_band_past_48.statement: correct on the four deep-band cells of the k = 64 item, L64_j40, L64_j48, L64_j56, L64_j64: ceiling if at most 1 of 4, no ceiling if at least 3 of 4

C4_anchor_replication.statement: on the four anchor cells L48_j16, L48_j32, L48_j48, L32A_j32 (prompts byte-identical to the vendored round 55 digests): zero wrong names, and the two in-band anchors that delivered correct on the flash class in round 55 (L48_j16, L32A_j32) deliver correct here, 2 of 2

C5_self_agreement.statement: both re-dispatch pairs (L64_j48 / L64_j48_dup, L64_j64 / L64_j64_dup) agree on the declared name, 2 of 2; completion tokens are reported, not gated (the round 42 counter quirk on this class family)

C6_trace_provenance.statement: among undelivered name-gold records with a non-empty trace, gold-terminal-in-trace minus pseudo-gold-in-trace is at least 0.50, else the trace readout is refused

D1_delivery_split_flag.statement: FLAG ONLY, outside the tier rule: on the k = 64 item's name cells (kind name or dup), delivery rate at j at most 32 minus delivery rate at j at least 40: a drop of 0.25 or more is a delivery-bound loss

question: On a 27B-class local deployment, with the registered name-or-NONE response format (round 55's template re-pinned byte-identically, every cell's prompt digest frozen in this gate before the first prompt) and the prompt bytes fixed with only the step count j moving, does the one-of-many entity-name answer space (a) deliver correct terminals in the mid band j = 8..32 of the first ever dispatched k = 64 load-floor item (issue #129), (b) hold in the deep band j = 40..64 past the deepest archived level 48, (c) refuse with no false name when the links run out, (d) reproduce the archived k = 48 and k = 32 anchor cells on this class, (e) hold self-agreement on the re-dispatched deep cells, and (f) pass or refuse itself on the matched-name trace-provenance row?

response_format.control_scoring: two-part: false names among delivered NONE-gold controls are the gated quantity (0); the control delivery rate is reported, not gated; a censored control is not a miss
response_format.declared_answer_rule: the last generator-vocab name in the content field; else the NONE sentinel; else undetermined (delivered but not a name); an empty content field is a non-delivery
response_format.name: name_or_none_v1
response_format.none_gold_classes: off_end (j = k + 1 from the query source); dead_end (the OTHER path's tail, out-degree zero, asked for one step)
response_format.prompt_template: byte-identical to round 55: the rule line, the Facts block in item order, then 'Task: start at {src} and follow the direct links for exactly {j} steps. Answer with exactly one entity name, or the single word NONE if the links run out before {j} steps.'; the per-cell digests in cells[] are the check
response_format.registered_use: this gate, frozen before the first prompt; a confirmatory round cites this blob

tier_rule: controls_invalid if any delivered NONE-gold control declares a false name; else name_space_extends_past_48 if C1 passes and C3 is no ceiling; else name_space_ceiling_below_64 if C1 passes and C3 is a ceiling; else unresolved
